shellCommands.command: find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "---" && cat next.config.ts
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n "$f"; done
grep -rn "^export .*\bio\b\|\bio\b" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- cache.js ---"; cat node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
grep -rn "io" node_modules/next/dist/server/request/io.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== exports in api/cache ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/api/ 2>/dev/null | head -30

find .next -name "product*" -path "*server/app*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== shell contents ==="; grep -o "Premium Widget\|Checking availability\|in stock" .next/server/app/product.html 2>/dev/null | sort -u

(npx next start -p 3111 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -N --no-buffer http://localhost:3111/product | while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s %s\n' "$(date +%s.%N | cut -c1-14)" "$(echo "$line" | grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Checking availability\|in stock' | head -1)"; done | grep -v ' $' | head

curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Checking availability\|in stock\|Price:' | sort -u; echo "=== headers ==="; curl -s -D- -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/product | grep -i "transfer-encoding\|cache-control\|x-nextjs"
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git diff --stat && echo "=== diff ===" && git diff -- app lib tsconfig.json
git diff --stat; echo "=== diff ==="; git diff -- app lib tsconfig.json
